newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Feb 3.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Peter Ford, London Underground chairman has urged Ministers not to rush in and sell-off the Tube (in its current decrepit state) at a knockdown price. He maintains that it would be far better waiting a few years to obtain the best price.
WEAK STOCKS AND YEN PUZZLE JAPAN
Today the Japanese Finance Minister admitted that he found it difficult to ascertain the reasons for the weakness of the yen and recent sharp falls on the Tokyo stock market.
QUEENSBOROUGH TIPPED TO BUY GRANADA PARK
Granada the leisure giant is in negotiations with Queensborough holdings to buy its American theme park, currently valued at 3 million stg.
A Philippines court has ordered the suspension of the privatisation of the Manila water and sewerage system, a project which involves Britain's United Utilities.
BAA BATTLES TO LAND BIG AIRPORTS DEAL
In order to stay in the bidding, BAA, the airports operator and one of the front-runners in the 3bn Australian dollar (1.5bn stg) airports sell-off, has had to dilute its stake in a local consortium.
